themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim. No modification. Added explicit pageBackground: #ffffff to document the implicit light register. Dark text (#000000, #1c1d21) on white background — luminance 255, qualifies as light register.

B. Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em for all heading sizes h1–h4). All proprietary fonts replaced with Google Fonts equivalents: Haffer XH SemiBold → Plus Jakarta Sans, Fragment Mono → Geist Mono, Jersey 10 → Space Grotesk, Satoshi → Inter (already Google Fonts). All woff2 references removed; replaced with CDN @import statements.

A. Duration scaling (slower) at intensity 2 (×1.3). All duration values multiplied by 1.3×: micro 0.05s→0.065s, quick 0.15s→0.195s, standard 0.3s→0.39s, expressive 0.7s→0.91s, cinematic 1.1s→1.43s. Deceleration-only easing philosophy preserved. Pacing is more deliberate — elements arrive with greater weight.

A. Container max-width tightening at intensity 2 (−15%). Container maxWidth reduced from 1240px to 1054px for a more editorial, focused layout. All column widths in grid definitions proportionally adjusted. Narrow container adjusted from 750px to 637.5px.
C. Hero padding emphasis at intensity 3 (×1.5). Hero padding scaled: top 96→144px, right/left 128→192px, bottom 64→96px, gap 24→36px. All other spacing values unchanged from source.

E. Focus state enhancement at intensity 3 (outlineWidth: 2px). Added outlineWidth: 2px focus states to all interactive elements — buttons, inputs, links, navigation. Enhances keyboard accessibility throughout. No color values modified.

D. Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 (0.08em). Added letterSpacing: 0.08em to nav typography for a precise, editorial quality to navigation links. Nav height 70px, itemSpacing 54.5px preserved from source.

C. Material shift applied to the Hero Section paragraph. Added specific detail about physical materiality: the texture of light on matte coated stock, the temperature of ink on touched paper — the gradient on type described through material analogy rather than visual description. concept_by_video.md generated fresh for this design system.

productConcept.name: Fieldset
productConcept.tagline: Structure Your Observations. Trust Your Findings.
productConcept.description: Structured research data platform for observational science teams. Captures, validates, and makes queryable field observations — from first observation to final finding.
